patch.value: Explain scheduled install mismatches and preserve redacted command failure diagnostics

The November 6 fleet watch still samples old workflow releases with silent exact-version verification failures and hidden closeout stderr. Existing normalization, pagination and no-op fixes require caller pin adoption. Strengthen the current workflow install verifier with actionable safe messages, preserve actionable non-JSON or host-wrapped error details through the diagnostic path, and record the per-caller adoption and validation inventory without changing caller repositories.

Real workflow regressions fail under function-only behavioral reversions; version mismatches identify safe expected and actual versions; command errors remain actionable after privacy redaction; existing gates still refuse publication; public caller replays distinguish package fixes from caller-owned policy and provenance.

value.text: REST evidence distinguishes old release adoption from current defects: padded tag verification silently exits after a healthy install; old repeated imports stamp updated_at; old closeout hides its actual failure. Existing main already normalizes tags and avoids repeated writes. This item adds safe install mismatch diagnostics and hardens failure receipt decoding, with executable workflow tests and the caller follow-up matrix on pm-github-samq.
